schemes.name: Maharashtra Startup Policy 2017
schemes.description: Comprehensive policy to promote entrepreneurship in Maharashtra with financial incentives, incubation support, and regulatory simplification for startups.
benefits: Patent filing reimbursement up to ₹5 lakh
schemes.eligibility: DPIIT recognized startups incorporated in Maharashtra with turnover below ₹100 crore
schemes.amendments: Amended in 2022 to include deep-tech and social enterprises

schemes.name: Maharashtra Maha-Fund
schemes.description: ₹500 Crore fund of funds for equity investment in Maharashtra-based startups through registered AIFs and venture capital funds.
benefits: Equity investment up to ₹10 crore per startup
schemes.eligibility: Maharashtra-incorporated startups at Seed, Series A, and Series B stages

schemes.name: Maharashtra Seed Fund Scheme
schemes.description: Government-backed seed funding of up to ₹25 lakh for early-stage Maharashtra startups through incubation centers.
schemes.eligibility: DPIIT recognized startups less than 5 years old with MVP and early traction

schemes.name: MSME Technology Upgradation Scheme
schemes.description: Capital subsidy for technology upgradation in MSMEs including automation, digital transformation, and process improvement.
schemes.eligibility: Maharashtra-registered MSMEs with Udyam registration and minimum 3 years of operation

schemes.name: Maharashtra Women Entrepreneurship Policy
schemes.description: Special incentives and support system for women entrepreneurs including dedicated fund, mentorship network, and skill development programs.
benefits: Dedicated seed fund up to ₹30 lakh
schemes.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs with at least 51% ownership in Maharashtra-incorporated startups

schemes.name: Digital Maharashtra Program
schemes.description: Digital transformation initiative supporting startups developing solutions for government service delivery and citizen engagement.
schemes.eligibility: Maharashtra startups with digital solutions for governance, citizen services, or digital infrastructure

schemes.name: Maharashtra Innovation Society (MIS) Schemes
schemes.description: Umbrella organization running multiple innovation support schemes including grants, incubation, and market access programs.
schemes.eligibility: Maharashtra startups and innovators with viable products or prototypes

schemes.name: Maharashtra EV Policy 2021
schemes.description: State policy promoting electric vehicle adoption and manufacturing in Maharashtra with incentives for EV startups, charging infrastructure, and battery technology.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹2 lakh per EV
schemes.eligibility: EV manufacturers, charging infrastructure providers, and battery technology startups in Maharashtra

schemes.name: Maharashtra IT Policy 2020
schemes.description: Comprehensive IT policy supporting software development, IT services, and tech startups with infrastructure and fiscal incentives.
schemes.eligibility: IT/ITES companies and tech startups registered in Maharashtra

schemes.name: Maharashtra AgriTech Policy
schemes.description: Policy promoting agricultural technology innovation in Maharashtra with focus on precision farming, supply chain optimization, and farmer connectivity.
benefits: AgriTech startup grants up to ₹50 lakh
schemes.eligibility: AgriTech startups working with Maharashtra farmers and agricultural value chains

schemes.name: Skill India Maharashtra
schemes.description: Skill development program aligned with national Skill India mission, providing training infrastructure and placement support for Maharashtra youth.
schemes.eligibility: Maharashtra youth aged 18-45 with minimum 8th standard education

schemes.name: Maharashtra Green Energy Policy
schemes.description: Policy promoting renewable energy adoption and green technology innovation in Maharashtra with incentives for solar, wind, and biomass startups.
schemes.eligibility: Clean energy startups and renewable energy project developers in Maharashtra

schemes.name: Maharashtra Healthcare Innovation Mission
schemes.description: Mission supporting healthcare innovation in Maharashtra with focus on rural health, telemedicine, and affordable medical devices.
schemes.eligibility: HealthTech startups with solutions for Maharashtra's public health challenges

schemes.name: Maharashtra Smart City Mission
schemes.description: State implementation of Smart Cities Mission supporting urban technology solutions in Maharashtra's 10 smart cities.
benefits: Project funding for smart city solutions
schemes.eligibility: Smart city solution providers registered in Maharashtra with proven pilots

schemes.name: Maharashtra Rural Innovation Fund
schemes.description: Fund supporting innovative solutions for rural Maharashtra's challenges in water, sanitation, agriculture, and livelihood creation.
schemes.eligibility: Social enterprises and innovators working on rural Maharashtra challenges
